immutable: This file is never changed after the first fit. Any later change is a protocol deviation and must be reported as such.
unit: whole fire (all cells and intervals of one fire belong to one partition)

fit.note: The archive contains no 2023 US fire; US fit years are therefore 2020 to 2022. Korean 2022 and 2023 fires have no perimeter series and enter only the mixed kriged-label regime.

development_folds.rule: leave-one-year-out over the US fit fires; Korean fit fires stay in every training fold of the mixed regime and are never a validation fold

held_out.rule: No development decision (variant, hyperparameter, epoch, threshold, interval rule) may use any held-out fire. Held-out fires are scored once, after the configuration in this file and in the frozen run configuration is fixed.

intervals.definition: consecutive distinct NIROPS survey times t1 < t2 of one fire component; the state at t is the union of that component's polygons with time <= t, rasterized at cell centres on the Zenodo 375 m grid
intervals.inclusion: 0 < t2 - t1 <= 48 h, decided from timestamps only (label-free); longer intervals are excluded for compute reasons
intervals.cells: known cells of the full event rectangle outside the initial union; outside the endpoint union is a negative mapped-extent outcome
intervals.environment: covariates at floor_hour(t1), repeated over the interval unless a sample is explicitly flagged as hourly reanalysis weather

c651_training_overlap: c651 was fit on cell-hours of KFS_02, KFS_03 and the 2020 to 2022 US fires listed above; no held-out fire entered its fitting, but its selection followed inspection of Wapiti and other test events, so c651 is not blind on the held-out set.
